edits.after: Training at work usually has a direction in mind.
edits.reason: Replace the cumbersome double negative while retaining that workplace development normally has goals.
edits.before: Development at work is rarely entirely without direction.

edits.after: It gradually teaches people how to make those judgments for themselves.
edits.reason: Naturalize handing over methods of judgment; preserve the autonomy-building purpose rather than only supplying answers.
edits.before: It gradually hands over the methods of judgment.

edits.after: Development that genuinely empowers people lets them leave with what they have learned.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'truly powerful development' without weakening portable capabilities and exit.
edits.before: Truly powerful development enables people to leave with what they have learned.

edits.after: Good development, then, involves the mentor gradually stepping back.
edits.reason: Clarify who steps back rather than make development itself the actor; the gradual transfer of judgment remains.
edits.before: Good development therefore moves toward gradually stepping back.

edits.after: If all growth does is repeat the existing direction, the organization becomes more skilled at continuing as it is, but gains no new possibilities. Shared capacity has truly increased when members can understand common goals and then propose different methods, even pointing out problems their mentors cannot see.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'a more proficient continuation' while preserving common goals, different methods and the possibility of correcting the mentor.
edits.before: If all growth can only repeat the existing direction, the organization gains a more proficient continuation, not new possibilities. Shared capacity has truly increased when members can understand common goals and then propose different methods, even pointing out problems their mentors cannot see.

edits.after: Al formar a alguien, tampoco se puede dejar de respetarlo como persona.
edits.reason: Replace the repetitive calque 'el lugar de cada persona como persona' with ordinary language without reducing personhood to role performance.
edits.before: La formación también necesita preservar el lugar de cada persona como persona.

edits.after: Consiste en ofrecer hechos, criterios, oportunidades y protección para que pueda hacerse responsable poco a poco de sus propios juicios y sea capaz de dirigirse hacia un futuro que ni siquiera quien la forma puede determinar por completo de antemano.
edits.reason: Clarify assuming responsibility for one's judgment rather than the awkward 'asumir su propio juicio'; retain all four supports and the open future.
edits.before: Consiste en ofrecer hechos, criterios, oportunidades y protección para que pueda asumir gradualmente su propio juicio y sea capaz de dirigirse hacia un futuro que ni siquiera quien la forma puede determinar por completo de antemano.

edits.after: Someone who has already taken many paths knows which seemingly attractive opportunities may carry hidden costs, and what certain choices may open or close several years later. Sharing this experience with someone just starting out can spare them unnecessary setbacks.
edits.reason: Replace the literal 'unnecessary collisions' with the intended career-learning meaning, preserving hidden costs and delayed consequences.
edits.before: Someone who has already taken many paths knows which seemingly attractive opportunities may carry hidden costs, and what certain choices may open or close several years later. Sharing this experience with someone just starting out can spare them many unnecessary collisions.

edits.after: For example, a manager says, “Staying on this path would be better for you.”
edits.reason: Use the natural English career-path expression rather than 'staying in this direction'.
edits.before: For example, a manager says, “Staying in this direction would be better for you.”

edits.after: A company is in a special position here.
edits.reason: Naturalize the clumsy comparative 'a more particular position' without changing the organization's distinct authority and interests.
edits.before: A company has a more particular position here.

edits.after: La empresa ocupa aquí una posición especial.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'una posición más particular' while preserving the distinct organizational role developed next.
edits.before: La empresa ocupa aquí una posición más particular.

edits.after: But management has an often-overlooked direction: it should gradually help people exercise their own judgment in more situations, instead of having to refer everything back to the manager forever.
edits.reason: People acquire capacity to judge, not a stock of judgments handed to them. Preserve gradual independence and the warning against permanent referral.
edits.before: But management has an often-overlooked direction: it should gradually give members more judgments they can make themselves, rather than making everything return to the manager forever.

edits.after: But if the manager must prevent every mistake in advance, no one else ever gets the chance to develop their own judgment and learn to take responsibility when it is wrong.
edits.reason: Clarify that people, rather than judgment as an abstract object, bear responsibility for their mistakes; retain the learning condition.
edits.before: But if they must eliminate every mistake in advance, no one else ever has the chance to develop judgment capable of bearing responsibility for mistakes.

edits.after: Pero, si quien dirige tiene que eliminar de antemano todos los errores, los demás nunca tienen ocasión de desarrollar un criterio propio y aprender a responder por los errores que cometan.
edits.reason: Make the learner's responsibility for errors clear instead of treating a criterio itself as capable of assuming errors.
edits.before: Pero si tiene que eliminar de antemano todos los errores, los demás nunca tienen ocasión de desarrollar un criterio capaz de asumirlos.

edits.after: El trabajo común sigue necesitando a alguien que decida entre necesidades contrapuestas de distintos equipos, distribuya los recursos y tenga la última palabra. Incluso los integrantes experimentados siguen necesitando comentarios y coordinación. Lo que se reduce es la dependencia innecesaria, no todas las relaciones.
edits.reason: Restore cross-team trade-offs, not merely generic decisions between teams. Preserve resources, final judgment, support for experienced staff and the non-isolation qualification.
edits.before: El trabajo común sigue necesitando que alguien asuma las decisiones entre equipos, la distribución de recursos y el juicio final. Incluso los integrantes experimentados siguen necesitando comentarios y coordinación. Lo que se reduce es la dependencia innecesaria, no todas las relaciones.

edits.after: There may be truth in that.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'may contain a fact' while retaining partial acknowledgment rather than denial or full endorsement.
edits.before: That statement may contain a fact.

edits.after: They invested time and may have imagined continuing to work together. Watching the other person grow and then leave can feel as though the possibilities they helped create are being taken away.
edits.reason: Make the mentor's genuine sense of loss idiomatic without converting that feeling into ownership or authority.
edits.before: They invested time and may have imagined continuing to work together. Seeing the other person leave after growing can feel as though a possibility they built with their own hands has been taken away.

edits.after: The crucial boundary is between acknowledging the past and handing over the future.
edits.reason: Clarify the temporal-boundary metaphor in plain prose; the next paragraph preserves explicit obligations that can survive departure.
edits.before: What truly needs protecting is the boundary between different times.

edits.after: Quien recibió un ascenso encuentra después difícil rechazar tareas adicionales; quien recibió ayuda debe, según se espera, presentarse ante cualquier urgencia; y quien fue perdonado una vez parece haber perdido desde entonces el derecho a pedir un trato justo.
edits.reason: Repair the cumbersome third clause and keep the three examples parallel without changing their scope.
edits.before: Alguien que fue ascendido encuentra después difícil rechazar tareas adicionales; quien recibió ayuda debe, según se espera, presentarse ante cualquier urgencia; a quien se le perdonó una vez algo parece que desde entonces se le haya retirado la legitimidad para pedir un trato justo.

edits.after: Lo que hay que preservar es la frontera entre reconocer el pasado y entregar el futuro.
edits.reason: 'El límite del tiempo' sounds like a deadline; make the intended acknowledgment-versus-ownership boundary explicit.
edits.before: Lo que realmente hay que preservar es el límite del tiempo.

edits.after: It does not tell them what happened or how to put it right. It leaves them facing a verdict on who they are, with no direct way to change it.
edits.reason: Replace the academic 'verdict on the self' with the concrete person-level label the essay is criticizing.
edits.before: It does not tell someone what happened or how to correct it. It merely confronts them with a verdict on the self that they cannot directly change.

edits.after: Feedback is not one person delivering a conclusion and asking the other to sign for it.
edits.reason: Preserve the source's receipt/signature image in idiomatic English.
edits.before: Feedback is not one party handing over a conclusion for the other to acknowledge receipt.

edits.after: It should let both sides work toward a shared understanding of what happened at work.
edits.reason: Naturalize the opening of shared understanding without implying guaranteed agreement; the following paragraph retains that qualification.
edits.before: It should open a process of shared understanding around the facts of the work.

edits.after: After hearing an explanation, a manager may still consider the standard unmet. The person being evaluated may disagree yet still have to face the organization's resulting decisions about their role. Allowing a response does not mean handing that person the final decision.
edits.reason: Replace opaque 'resulting role arrangements' while retaining disagreement, organizational decision authority and the limit of a right to respond.
edits.before: After hearing an explanation, a manager may still consider the standard unmet. The person evaluated may disagree yet still have to face the organization's resulting role arrangements. Allowing a response does not mean handing that person the final decision.

edits.after: It simply recognizes that the person being evaluated can still explain facts and give reasons. They are not merely a set of results to be read.
edits.reason: Make the person-versus-readable-result contrast natural while preserving the agency and explanation rights at issue.
edits.before: It merely recognizes that someone being evaluated remains capable of explaining facts and reasons, rather than being a result that can only be read.

edits.after: Recognition should not be reserved for the biggest results.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'appear only where results are greatest'; the prevention/cooperation examples remain immediately afterward.
edits.before: Recognition cannot appear only where results are greatest.

edits.after: La organización dice a alguien que necesita mejorar, pero no le proporciona formación, tiempo o criterios más claros; le pide que ejerza más su propio criterio, pero sigue reteniendo toda la información en los niveles superiores. Esos comentarios convierten las deficiencias de la organización en una tarea de desarrollo individual.
edits.reason: The source asks for more independent judgment, which is not identical to assigning more final decisions. Preserve the missing-information and unsupported-growth critique.
edits.before: La organización dice a alguien que necesita mejorar, pero no le proporciona formación, tiempo o criterios más claros; le pide que asuma más decisiones, pero sigue reteniendo toda la información en los niveles superiores. Esos comentarios convierten las deficiencias de la organización en una tarea de desarrollo individual.

edits.after: El reconocimiento no debe limitarse a los grandes resultados.
edits.reason: Naturalize the awkward 'cuando los resultados son mayores' without omitting the quieter contributions explained next.
edits.before: El reconocimiento no puede aparecer únicamente cuando los resultados son mayores.

review_scope.reading_basis: Read every paragraph and title of the formal ZIP Chinese, English and Spanish manuscripts for work16–20 in bounded untruncated outputs. Total777 body-paragraph readings. No unread paragraphs. Intake helper checked paragraph text against supplied Markdown/alignment.
review_scope.semantic_review: Full comparison of argument, examples and qualifications. Preserved training direction and legitimate role requirements; gradual independent judgment; proportional explicit exchanges rather than unlimited gratitude-debt; advisers own standpoint; shared goals and real management support rather than isolation; supported learning failures; portable abilities and exit; and feedback tied to evidence rather than total identity. Complete paragraph structure and all examples retained.
review_scope.local_scope: Localized prose and precision repairs, especially learning to answer for mistakes rather than judgment itself doing so, cross-team trade-offs, temporal acknowledgment versus future ownership, and independent judgment versus final decision rights. No Chinese source-level revision found necessary in this batch.
review_scope.metadata: All five English titles are unnumbered and naturalized; Spanish16/19 titles polished. Other Spanish titles are already unnumbered and natural.
review_scope.limits: Normative editorial/fidelity review, not exhaustive external legal, medical or empirical factchecking. No new external facts, translation service, supplied HTML execution, ZIP/repo changes, integration, visual QA, commit or publication.
